name: Statue City Cruises · island visit
Statue City Cruises・上島參觀
text: The only option here that lands on Liberty Island. Includes island grounds and museum; no Ellis Island stop in this schedule, no crown climb. Best for learning the history.
本比較中唯一登上 Liberty Island 的選項。包含島上景點及博物館；本行程不前往 Ellis Island，亦不攀登皇冠，最適合深入了解歷史。

name: Staten Island Ferry · harbour view
Staten Island Ferry・海港遠眺
text: About 25min each crossing plus terminal waiting and reboarding. View the Statue from a distance; then use 10:30–12:15 for Wall Street / Federal Hall exterior and the 9/11 Memorial plaza. Museum not included.
每程約25分鐘，另計候船及重新登船。從遠處觀看 Statue；10:30–12:15 可選 Wall Street／Federal Hall 外觀及 9/11 Memorial 廣場，不包括博物館。

name: Circle Line · Liberty Midtown Cruise
Circle Line・Liberty Midtown Cruise
price: 估算每人 US$35–45・全家 US$105–135
text: A narrated skyline / Statue photo cruise from Pier 83, with indoor seating. No island landing. Reserve only if a winter departure returns by 11:15; otherwise choose the island or free ferry. Allow 30–45min boarding buffer.
由 Pier 83 出發，沿途講解城市天際線及拍攝 Statue，設室內座位，不登島。只選擇可在11:15前返回的冬季班次，另預留30–45分鐘登船；否則選上島或免費渡輪。

time: 只安排2月8日週一・暫定10:00起飛
text: Published US$259 + mandatory US$45 facility/fuel per seat; 12–15min in the air, arrive 30min early. No island landing. Manhattan tourist flights do not operate Sunday.
